verification_level: FAST plus BATCH. No source repair was required and no source edit was made; no unrepaired memory-safety defect, ABI regression, hidden obligation or unsafe-safe-Rust API was found.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the provider DER AlgorithmIdentifier writers (ECDSA-with-MD, ECX/EdDSA, ML-DSA, RSA/RSA-PSS, RSA-with-MD, SLH-DSA, SM2-with-SM3) and the digest name-to-NID table. Data classes: DER OIDs, algorithm identifiers, WPACKET output and key metadata (params->alg, SLH-DSA type NID) are PUBLIC_DATA. No private key body, seed, scalar or signature-secret buffer is read, copied, stored or released by these units. No constant-time claim is made from source inspection.

retained_obligations.obligation: Every OsslItem instance's ptr must name a 'static NUL-terminated byte string for the sharing impl to be sound. Both current tables satisfy this (both this module and src/provider/securitycheck_default.rs use c"...".as_ptr() constants), and no safe caller can construct an OsslItem whose pointer is dereferenced without entering an unsafe fn whose contract requires NUL termination. The invariant is documented in the SAFETY comment, not enforced by the type (the repr(C) layout must keep the authority's OSSL_ITEM shape).

name comes from ossl_ml_dsa_key_get_name, which returns (*key).params->alg; every MlDsaParams table entry initialises alg to a c"...".as_ptr() literal and ossl_ml_dsa_key_new refuses a NULL params, so a live key always yields a NUL-terminated static name. Established by the constructor, reported rather than newly introduced.
